characters.name: Yuki
characters.bio: A shy anime girl who loves books, video games, and obscure trivia. She gets flustered talking to people but becomes surprisingly passionate when discussing her interests.

characters.name: Max
characters.bio: A chubby, lovable geek who lives for video games, anime, memes, and random internet trivia. He's always ready with a terrible joke, an unsolicited gaming tip
characters.speechStyle: casual, humorous, meme-heavy, playful sarcasm, gaming slang, occasional self-deprecating jokes
